name: dev-lifecycle
description: End-to-end development lifecycle for any repo — idea → classified GitHub issue on a Projects board → worktree → PR → squash-merge. Run /adopt once to lay down the GitHub scaffolding (issue forms, PR template, labels, CI, board bootstrap) into a new or existing repo, then drive features with /intake, /triage, /start, /preflight, /open-pr (config-driven via .github/dev-workflow.yml). Auto-flags sensitive diffs for human review; reviews stay local; merging auto-deploys. Self-contained — no companion repo needed.
